name: colloq
description: One link, one live notebook, one AI. Self-hosted workspace for technical seminars.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @colloq/web && npm run build -w @colloq/server && npm run build -w @colloq/runtime
scripts.build:optimized: npm run build:optimized -w @colloq/web && npm run build -w @colloq/server && npm run build -w @colloq/runtime
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @colloq/server && npm run typecheck -w @colloq/web && npm run typecheck -w @colloq/runtime && npm run typecheck -w @colloq/cli
scripts.docs:check: python3 docs/build.py && git diff --exit-code -- site/docs site/sitemap.xml
